title: SafyaClinic
tagline: Clinic management: an Arabic public website plus staff tools for operations and payments.
challenge: Payment deduction rates vary by clinic and referral source. Applying updated rates to older payments would silently change historical financial records.
solution: Each payment stores the deduction rate applied at the time, instead of relying only on the current rate configuration. Corrections and cancellations go through an audit trail.
result: Rate changes leave historical payment calculations intact, and every correction or cancellation stays traceable.

title: Student Management System
tagline: Student records web app: search by name, email or ID, with departments and enrollment status.
challenge: Keep student records easy to browse and search across departments and enrollment states.
solution: A Python back end exposes a REST API over MySQL; the web interface searches by name, email or ID and shows enrollment details.
result: Live on Render with a read-only demo account and sample data, so anyone can explore it safely.

credentials.note: Public read-only demo account with sample data. The free host may take up to a minute to wake up.

screenshots.caption: Student records with search and enrollment status.

title: This portal
tagline: A data-driven profile site in TypeScript, Vite and GSAP, with no UI framework.
challenge: Show 25+ years across six IT domains without overwhelming the reader, while proving current front-end skills in the site itself.
solution: Content lives in typed JSON files rendered by small TypeScript modules. Motion uses Canvas, CSS 3D and GSAP, and every effect has a reduced-motion fallback.
result: About 60 KB of JavaScript, keyboard and screen-reader friendly, and every animation can be paused.
